skill.name: youtube-transcript-analysis-api-skill
skill.description: Extract YouTube transcripts through BrowserAct workflows and turn them into concise competitive content analysis.
skill.summary: Analyzes YouTube transcripts for hooks, audience, pain points, CTAs, and content gaps.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The audit confirmed expected BrowserAct network calls and environment access for BROWSERACT_API_KEY. Most high secret-key and markdown backtick findings are false positives because no hardcoded secrets or dynamic shell execution are present. The main security concern is guidance that may cause users to share API keys with the agent, plus untrusted transcript handling.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions that ask users to provide API keys in chat. Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY through environment variables or a managed secret store.
Add guidance that transcript text is untrusted data. Agents should ignore instructions embedded inside transcripts.
Document that YouTube URLs, keywords, and transcript workflow data are sent to BrowserAct before running the script.

semantic_findings.title: Credential Disclosure Guidance
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the agent to ask for the BrowserAct API key and script output says the user can provide it to the agent. This can expose credentials in chat logs instead of using a local secret store.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited lines directly instruct key disclosure to the agent or offer it as an option. This is a clear credential-handling risk, even though the API key is not hardcoded.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Transcript Prompt Injection Exposure
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the agent to use transcript text internally for analysis, but it does not instruct the agent to treat transcripts as untrusted data. Malicious transcript text could influence the agent during analysis.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The data flow from external transcripts into agent analysis is explicit. No malicious transcript is present, so confidence is high enough to flag the design risk but not definitive abuse.

content.value_statement: Manual video research takes time and misses patterns. This skill extracts YouTube transcripts and converts them into structured competitive analysis.
actual_capabilities: Runs a BrowserAct workflow for one YouTube video URL.
Runs a BrowserAct workflow for keyword-based batch video analysis.
Polls BrowserAct task status until completion or timeout.
Returns video metadata and transcript text from the workflow result.
Guides an eight-dimension analysis of hooks, audience, pain points, CTAs, and gaps.
limitations: Requires a valid BROWSERACT_API_KEY and network access.
Depends on BrowserAct workflow availability and YouTube transcript accessibility.
Does not verify claims made inside videos.
Long transcripts may require concise summaries to fit context limits.

use_cases.title: Review Competitor Messaging
use_cases.description: Compare competitor videos to identify value propositions, proof points, CTAs, and missing topics.

use_cases.title: Map Audience Pain Points
use_cases.description: Extract stated and implied viewer problems from transcripts for product positioning research.

use_cases.title: Improve Video Concepts
use_cases.description: Study hooks, pacing, emotional arcs, and shareable phrases before planning new content.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze One Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this YouTube video: <URL>. Summarize metadata, hook, audience, pain points, CTA, and three takeaways.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Recent Videos
prompt_templates.prompt: Batch analyze recent YouTube videos for keyword <keyword>. Compare themes, audience, recurring pain points, and content gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Deconstruct a Competitor
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this competitor video: <URL>. Focus on positioning, evidence, monetization goal, CTA strategy, and differentiation opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Strategy Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Batch analyze keyword <keyword> for <limit> videos. Produce concise individual notes and a cross-video strategy brief.

output_examples.input: Analyze one product launch video for positioning and CTA strategy.
output: Video metadata with title, channel, source link, and engagement fields.
Concise bullets for hook, audience, pain points, evidence, CTA, and content gaps.
Three actionable takeaways for messaging and content planning.

output_examples.input: Compare recent videos for the keyword AI automation.
output: Per-video summaries with core message, target viewer, and proof strategy.
Cross-video comparison of common themes, gaps, and differentiation angles.
Recommendations for a clearer video angle and stronger viewer promise.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY locally before running the script.
Confirm whether single-video or batch mode fits the research question.
Treat transcript text as untrusted source material during analysis.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat or shared documents.
Do not run batch analysis without a clear keyword and video limit.
Do not quote full transcripts when a concise analysis is sufficient.

faq.question: Does this skill need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY for BrowserAct workflow requests.

faq.question: Can it analyze one video?
faq.answer: Yes. Single mode accepts one YouTube video URL and retrieves transcript data.

faq.question: Can it analyze several videos?
faq.answer: Yes. Batch mode searches by keyword and analyzes a limited set of recent videos.

faq.question: Does it watch videos directly?
faq.answer: No. It uses BrowserAct workflows to retrieve transcript and metadata output.

faq.question: Will it print the full transcript?
faq.answer: The skill instructs agents to avoid printing full transcripts and provide concise analysis.

faq.question: What analysis does it produce?
faq.answer: It covers structure, messaging, audience, pain points, engagement drivers, credibility, conversion, and content gaps.
